adjudication_summary: The previous no-activity-row and framework-only adjudication failures are repaired. Remaining issues are caution-level source limitations, not open rework targets: ambiguous database acyl identity, database FICI not found in primary source, and non-digitized figure curves.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows were rechecked against Table 1, Figure 1, article metadata, and merged database CSVs. Rows that cannot be acyl-resolved or whose FICI/database text is not primary-source exposed remain source_conflict with explicit context; literature links and the C12X source-supported rows are source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary Table 1 supplies OAK HC50, OAK MIC, rifampin-sensitization MIC, and penicillin G MIC rows for E. coli ML-35p. Supplementary Table S1 supplies rifampin MIC and sensitization factor rows across the GNB panel for C12(omega7)KKc12K and C10KKc12K.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is accepted with cautions: direct OM/CM permeabilization assays, LPS-binding context, time-kill/delay phenotype, and depolarization context are preserved; no unsupported graph digitization or RNA-polymerase/OAK direct target claim is promoted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP local sequence snapshots encode several OAK derivatives as KKXK without N-terminal acyl details; source-supported activity rows are retained, while database IDs 12353/12354/12355 are not smoothed to source_verified.
DBAASP synergy rows include FICI values that are not exposed in the local primary XML/PDF/supplement text; source-supported MIC/SF rows are used instead.

Supplementary Table S1 penicillin G rowspans are layout-ambiguous in local extracted text; Table 1 penicillin values and the no-sensitization conclusion are preserved without inventing per-strain rows.
Figure-only MIC/permeabilization/time-kill curves were used only for qualitative/context claims unless exact values were present in captions/text/tables.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/supplementary PDF and linked database snapshots were sufficient for owner-layer repair; unsupported exact graph/table-layout values were recorded as nonblocking gaps rather than fabricated.

tools_attempted: rg over merged sequence and experiment CSVs
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local DBAASP sequence rows collapse the OAKs to KKXK and do not encode the N-terminal acyl group; primary Table 1 identifies C12(omega7)X/C10X/C8X/C12X, so database IDs 12353/12354/12355 are preserved as source_conflict where acyl-specific identity is not directly recoverable from the local database snapshot.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Database layer keeps source_conflict cautions; activity/toxicity values are still source-supported from Table 1 and Supplementary Table S1.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local supplementary PDF layout renders the Penicillin G panel with rowspans that do not safely assign every GNB strain to a separate exact row. The main XML and Table 1 support the curation-level conclusion that the tested OAKs did not sensitize bacteria to penicillin G, and exact E. coli ML-35p Table 1 values are captured.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No activity/database blocker remains; unsupported per-strain penicillin panel values were not fabricated.
